sections.approach: 1) Transliterate letters NFKD cannot decompose using a fixed table (ß/ẞ -> ss, æ -> ae, ø -> o, œ -> oe, đ/ð -> d, ł -> l, þ -> th) before normalizing. 2) Apply unicode NFKD decomposition, which also expands compatibility forms (ligature ﬁ -> fi, Ⅻ -> XII, ① -> 1). 3) Diacritic stripping: remove combining marks U+0300-U+036F. 4) Remove apostrophes (' and ’) without a separator. 5) Lowercase conversion. 6) Split into words on every run of characters outside [a-z0-9] and join with the separator option (default '-'), so separators never repeat or lead/trail. 7) maxLength: add whole words while they fit; if the first word alone is too long, cut it to maxLength.
sections.edge_cases: Empty or whitespace-only input returns an empty string; separator-only input (---) returns empty; repeated separators (a--b__c) collapse; leading or trailing punctuation is trimmed; german sharp s (both cases) becomes ss; diacritics are stripped (Crème -> creme); ligatures, roman numerals and circled digits are expanded by NFKD; non-latin characters such as 東京 are dropped; apostrophes join words (Don't -> dont); a first word longer than maxLength is hard-cut; output never ends with a separator; the function is idempotent for the same options; non-string input throws TypeError and an invalid separator or maxLength throws RangeError.
